## Four highlighters

One loop, four classes: [orange]{.fragment .hl-orange}, [yellow]{.fragment .hl-yellow},
[brown]{.fragment .hl-brown}, and [pink]{.fragment .hl-pink}.

The current one is the strongest, and the ones behind it settle back a shade.
